Chi Xu
Ph.D. Candidate
Computer Science and Engineering
HKUST

Chi Xu (徐驰) is a third year Ph.D. student major in Computer Science and Engineering under the supervision of Prof. Qian Zhang, in HKUST. His research interests include Smart Healthcare, Human Computer Interaction, Machine Learning, Software Engineering. He got his bachelor's degree of Computer Science and Engineering from Southern University of Science and Technology in 2023.
